WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TRAN_DATE_BAL)),0) TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),VALUE_DATE_BAL)),0) VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN)),0) VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_LNS_EODACCTBALFULL WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT cast(REPLACE(TRIM(H),'F-','') AS numeric(38,10)) COUNT_src
,cast(TRAN_DATE_BAL AS numeric(38,5)) TRAN_DATE_BAL_src
,cast(VALUE_DATE_BAL AS numeric(38,5)) VALUE_DATE_BAL_src
,cast(VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS numeric(38,5)) VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_LNS_EODACCTBALFULL WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,TRAN_DATE_BAL_src
,VALUE_DATE_BAL_src
,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src
,TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt
,VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt
,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)
SELECT * INTO #CTE12_LNS_EAB from CTE12;


INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS numeric(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(TRAN_DATE_BAL_src AS numeric(25,5)) TRAN_DATE_BAL_src
,CAST(VALUE_DATE_BAL_src AS numeric(25,5)) VALUE_DATE_BAL_src
,CAST(VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src AS numeric(25,5)) VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src
,CAST(TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt
,CAST(VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt
,CAST(VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt AS numeric(25,5)) VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM #CTE12_LNS_EAB
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,TRAN_DATE_BAL_src
,VALUE_DATE_BAL_src
,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt
,VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt
,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
